description: This file contains utility functions and constants for managing and resolving Node.js runtime paths, versions, and environment detection within a larger project.

classes.name: SystemNodeInfo
classes.description: Represents information about a system Node.js installation, including its path, version, and support status.

methods.name: getPathModule
methods.description: Returns the appropriate path module (win32 or posix) based on the platform.

methods.name: isNodeExecPath
methods.description: Checks if a given executable path corresponds to a Node.js executable.

methods.name: normalizeForCompare
methods.description: Normalizes file paths for comparison, considering platform-specific case sensitivity.

methods.name: buildSystemNodeCandidates
methods.description: Builds a list of potential system Node.js executable paths based on environment and platform.

methods.name: resolveNodeVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the Node.js version from a given executable path.

methods.name: isVersionManagedNodePath
methods.description: Determines if a path is managed by a version manager like nvm, fnm, etc.

methods.name: isSystemNodePath
methods.description: Checks if a path points to a system-installed Node.js.

methods.name: resolveSystemNodePath
methods.description: Finds the first accessible system Node.js path from candidates.

methods.name: resolveSystemNodeInfo
methods.description: Provides detailed info about the system Node.js installation, including version and support status.

methods.name: renderSystemNodeWarning
methods.description: Generates a warning message if the system Node.js version is unsupported.

methods.name: resolvePreferredNodePath
methods.description: Determines the preferred Node.js executable path, considering current process and system installations.
